content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD MPI ghost-cell exchange and global-to-local distribution utilities, all four subroutines guarded by '# if defined (PARALLEL)' variants (L45, L172, L304, L431). SUBROUTINE phi_exch(PHI) (L55-169, history 02/14/2011 Jeff Harris / 05/01/2011 Fengyan Shi L51-52): non-blocking ghost exchange of a REAL(SP) field PHI(Mloc,Nloc). East-west phase with len=Nloc*Nghost (L69): for each existing neighbor posts MPI_IRECV then packs Nghost interior columns into a send buffer - west sends sWmsg(j,i)=PHI(Ibeg+i-1,j) (L78) with recv tag 0/send tag 1 (L74-75, L82-83), east sends sEmsg(j,i)=PHI(Iend-i+1,j) (L92) with recv tag 1/send tag 0 (L88-89, L96-97) - then MPI_WAITALL (L100) and unpacks into ghost columns PHI(Ibeg-i,j)=rWmsg(j,i) (L105), PHI(Iend+i,j)=rEmsg(j,i) (L113). North-south phase with len=Mloc*Nghost (L120): south pack sSmsg(i,j)=PHI(i,Jbeg+j-1) (L129), north pack sNmsg(i,j)=PHI(i,Jend-j+1) (L143), MPI_WAITALL (L151), unpack PHI(i,Jbeg-j)=rSmsg(i,j) (L156) and PHI(i,Jend+j)=rNmsg(i,j) (L164). SUBROUTINE phi_exch_variable_length(PHI,Mloc,Nloc,Ibeg,Iend,Jbeg,Jend,Nghost) (L184-299): identical algorithm but grid dimensions are dummy arguments (L189) with an explicit USE GLOBAL,ONLY list for MPI topology variables (L186); same pack/unpack anchors at L208/L222/L235/L243 (east-west) and L259/L273/L286/L294 (north-south). SUBROUTINE phi_int_exch(PHI) (L314-427): same algorithm for an INTEGER field using MPI_INTEGER (buffers declared INTEGER L323-324; pack/unpack at L337/L351/L364/L372 and L388/L402/L415/L423). SUBROUTINE DISTRIBUTE_VarGlob(VarGlob,PHI) (L446-543, history 09/24/2011 Fengyan Shi + 05/08/2017 Young-Kwang Choi; header comment block duplicated L432-445): rank 0 copies the MGlob x NGlob global field into ghost-padded PHIGLOB shifted by Nghost (L466-471) and fills ghost frames by edge replication (L472-488); every rank computes its ghost-extended global index window Nista/Niend/Njsta/Njend = iista/iiend/jjsta/jjend + Nghost (L492-495); four MPI_Gather calls collect all windows to rank 0 (L499-506); rank 0 keeps its own block PHI=PHIGLOB(1:Mloc,1:Nloc) (L508-510) and for each other rank slices xx=PHIGLOB(istanum:iendnum,jstanum:jendnum) (window +-Nghost, L514-524) sending via mpi_isend/mpi_wait (L525-526) while the target rank sizes lenx=Niend-Nista+1+2*Nghost (L531-533) and receives directly into PHI via mpi_irecv/mpi_wait (L535-536); temporary arrays deallocated (L527, L541).

verbatim_spans.text: !    phi_exch is the subroutine to exchange variable at processor interface

unresolved: Send/receive buffers for east-west are declared (Nloc,Nghost) but packed with index order (j,i) where j runs over Nloc (L78 etc.) - consistent within this file but transposed relative to the (Mloc,Nghost) north-south convention (i,j)
phi_int_exch header comment @L307 still says 'phi_exch' (copied); DISTRIBUTE_VarGlob has its descriptive comment block duplicated verbatim (L432-438 and L439-445)
DISTRIBUTE_VarGlob rank-0 self block PHI=PHIGLOB(1:Mloc,1:Nloc) @L509 assumes rank 0's window starts at global origin (Nistas(1)-Nghost=1); same construct as GLOB_to_LOC in mod_subgrid.F

Message tags pair west recv 0/east send 0 and west send 1/east recv 1 (L74-97) so simultaneous bidirectional exchanges do not collide; corners are handled implicitly because east-west exchanges full Nloc columns including ghost rows filled by the subsequent north-south phase only after this phase - ghost corners receive values from the second phase using already-exchanged columns

phi_exch uses blanket USE GLOBAL (L57) for Mloc/Nloc/loop indices i,j while phi_exch_variable_length shadows the global dims with dummies (L189) but still gets i,j from GLOBAL via USE list omission - loop indices i,j,irank etc. are not declared locally in any of the four subroutines
DISTRIBUTE_VarGlob sends each slab with mpi_isend immediately followed by mpi_wait (L525-526) making the transfers effectively blocking and serialized over ranks
